description: Record what happened to a Reddit, LinkedIn or X opportunity: replied (the user posted their answer — include the link), ignored (not a fit, with an optional reason that sharpens future ranking), snoozed (come back later) or open (put it back on the board).

posted_url.description: Link to the user's posted reply, when status is replied.

reason.description: Why it was ignored, e.g. 'wrong audience' or 'already answered'. Shapes future ranking.

snooze_days.description: Days to hide it when snoozed. Defaults to 3.

name: update_opportunity
title: Mark a conversation replied, ignored or snoozed
